levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: One or more of the four parts (subject, greeting, single clear request, closing) is missing or unclear.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: All four parts are present and each clearly serves its function.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: All four parts are present, and the subject line alone would let the recipient understand the topic before opening the email.

levels.label: Emerging
levels.descriptor: The request is buried in extra context, or the tone reads as overly casual for an adult outside the family.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The single request is stated plainly, and the tone is appropriately professional.

levels.label: Advanced
levels.descriptor: Same as proficient, and the learner names a specific, correct tone choice made because of the audience.

lookFors: Exactly one request appears in the body, not several bundled together.
The revision response names a real sentence that was changed, not a generic 'I fixed some wording.'

nonDiagnosticGuard: Do not infer effort, motivation, diagnosis, or character from an error.
